decision_maker.name: Dr Laurence E. Day (laurenceday)

comment_body: I approve Morpho as the sixth kickoff venue: slot 6, venue Morpho, rows morpho-optimizers, morpho-blue and morpho-midnight, with the scope recorded in https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1996.
boundary: The maintainer's own comment adds a sixth ordered slot after the five Dave Coleman approved on 2026-09-13. It selects the Morpho rows and their order; it does not change the five slots, establish deployment identity, approve capture spending or change downstream acceptance.
